style: Children's greeting card illustration for a premium baby and nursery shop, soft dreamy storybook style: digital watercolour with airbrushed glow, soft bokeh dots and a few small gold stars. Rounded, plump, gentle characters with rosy cheeks. Mood: tender, warm, a little magical. Vertical portrait composition with a calm, uncluttered lower third. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no border, no watermark.
